summary: Iteration 83 — Moodboards Inspirations Flow™ (Phase C / Slice 2 — MoodPanel + Quick Add). Backend: 6/7 pass (1 CRITICAL bug: POST /api/moodboards/{id}/blocks drops the `metadata` field — Pydantic BlockCreate schema and create_block handler do NOT accept/persist metadata_json, even though the frontend sends rich curatorial provenance: brand, inspiration_id, display_meta, source_type, editorial_filter, market_context). Inspirations archive (editorial/product/brand filters), catalogs, display-meta PATCH and usage-events all work. Frontend: MoodPanel renders correctly, 4 tabs visible, old 'Inspirations Hub Coming soon' placeholder gone, Products tab shows 80 tiles with 'Prodotto' badge, brand-input only on Products, atmosphere chip toggles is-on, collections tab renders, no forbidden jargon detected. Editorial Inspirations tab returned 0 tiles (acceptable empty state per spec — only Product seed data exists in archive currently).

critical.issue: BlockCreate Pydantic schema (backend/routers/moodboards_v1.py:196-206) does NOT declare a `metadata` field, and create_block() (line 550-584) does NOT write metadata_json. As a result, all Quick Add curatorial metadata (inspiration_id, brand, display_meta, editorial_filter, source_type, market_context) sent by MoodPanel's addInspirationBlock callback is silently dropped on creation. Verified by POST + GET roundtrip: metadata dict comes back as {}. This breaks the entire Brand Intelligence / Cultural Coherence promise of Slice 2 for newly-added blocks. BlockUpdate already supports metadata, so a follow-up PATCH would work — but Quick Add does not patch after create.

minor.issue: Returns 0 items for demo tenant — spec said '5+ items'; the Inspirations™ tab therefore renders the empty state. Either seed editorial inspirations or update the spec.

integration_issues.issue: Even if the UI POST contains content.src + style.focal_point + metadata.{...}, the backend strips metadata. ImageBlock.composeFilter() will therefore never receive editorial_filter from block.metadata for newly-added Quick Add blocks (verified: no CSS filter present on canvas s after Quick Add).

rca of the issue: Root cause = schema/handler asymmetry. BlockUpdate(BaseModel) declares metadata (line 218) and update_block() merges/persists it (line 610-615); duplicate_block (line 667) copies metadata_json; batch update (line 709) writes metadata_json. ONLY the create path (BlockCreate line 196-206 + create_block line 565-576) omits metadata. Frontend already sends the right payload — see MoodboardEditor.addInspirationBlock at line 350-388 — but Pydantic silently drops unknown fields on input (default behavior), and the handler never reads them. Mitigation: 2-line fix on the backend (add field to schema + add metadata_json to insert row). Once shipped, the existing failing pytest will go green and ImageBlock's editorial filter will start applying on Quick Add.
